crossRefs.note: “But that servant went out, and found one of his fellow servants, who owed him one hundred denarii, and he grabbed him…
When he had agreed with the laborers for a denarius a day, he sent them into his vineyard.
I heard a voice in the middle of the four living creatures saying, “A choenix of wheat for a denarius, and three…

translations.web: Show me the tax money.” They brought to him a denarius.
translations.bsb: Show Me the coin used for the tax.” And they brought Him a denarius.
translations.kjv: Shew me the tribute money. And they brought unto him a penny.
translations.asv: Show me the tribute money. And they brought unto him a denarius.
